intent: Make the verified P1 graph consumer gate discoverable without changing runtime behavior.

design.interface: Operators invoke make overnight-graph-smoke; the documentation states what that one command proves and what it deliberately does not prove.
call_flow: target calls the released Harness 1.3.0 through disposable repositories
five trajectory outcomes and isolation checks return one terminal verdict
invariants: documentation never claims fixture history is a real MythOS mission
the command remains offline and leaves the product worktree, ledger, and claim untouched
remote publication, repair enablement, and real mission approval remain separate authority gates
design.rollback: Revert the single documentation commit; no runtime, schema, or persisted product state changes.

slices.done: Both MythOS engineering interpretations name make overnight-graph-smoke, enumerate all five fixture paths, state that it is offline/disposable and not a real mission, and the temporary mission item is checked complete.

command: from pathlib import Path; loop=Path('docs/engineering/mythos/LOOP.md').read_text(); verification=Path('docs/engineering/mythos/VERIFICATION.md').read_text(); plan=Path('docs/plans/2026-07-26-p2-first-mission.md').read_text(); combined=loop+verification; required=('make overnight-graph-smoke','design-blocked','accepted','reverted','repaired','paused','disposable','not a real mission'); assert all(token in combined for token in required); assert '- [x] [auto:claude]' in plan
